wage_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wage) as avg_wage FROM (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wage FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
